outcome_data_inspected_before_freeze_not: This prereg is frozen before any reconciliation statistic (per-edge variance-explained, robustness-ladder edge sets, tercile/stability overlap, block-bootstrap selection frequency) is computed. The only prior inspection is metadata/coverage (row counts, null fractions, timestamp ranges, per-coin event counts, panel sha256) required to make the design executable. No target distribution, edge weight, causality p-value, variance-explained value, or network metric was observed.
campaign_rationale: FCLR-LIQ-CONTAGION-001 (session_20261121T193000Z, COMPLETE) disclosed an unresolved methodological discrepancy: eval edge set = 11 edges (Granger-Bonferroni INTERSECT permutation-Bonferroni, density 0.0524) vs independent recompute edge set = 58 edges (empirical-p only, density 0.2762), disagreeing on 47 of 210 directed pairs. The declared 2% per-edge materiality floor was asserted True but never actually computed (no per-edge variance-explained field exists). Funding-tercile and temporal-stability results were never reconciled against the primary edge set. FCLR-LIQ-CONTAGION-002 reuses the SAME frozen panel (no new data, no external trigger, no credentials) to compute per-edge materiality and reconcile edge-set criteria.

combined_liquidation_panel.null_notes: fundingRate, abs_fund_pct, notional_usd, rv24h, rv168h are non-null on all 1,740,415 rows. premium is present but not required by this protocol.

hypotheses.description: When the 2% per-edge variance-explained floor is actually computed within each VAR(6) Granger regression, the number of contagion edges clearing it is reported with a confidence interval, and the claim "contagion is material" is promoted or demoted accordingly (replacing CONTAGION-001's asserted-but-uncomputed flag).
hypotheses.estimand: Partial R-squared / variance explained in coin B's hourly liquidation intensity attributable to coin A's lagged liquidations, beyond coin B's own lags, for each directed (A->B) pair.
hypotheses.materiality_definition: An edge is material only if its partial variance explained >= 0.02 (2% of coin B's liquidation-intensity variance). Frozen; not relaxed after outcomes.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Report per-edge variance_explained and the fraction/count of edges clearing 0.02, with a bootstrap confidence interval. If the count clearing the floor is 0, record NOT_SUPPORTED for H_recon_materiality; if > 0 with stable bootstrap support, record SUPPORTED.

hypotheses.description: The contagion edge set is characterised across raw p<0.01, Bonferroni (alpha=0.01/210), Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05, and permutation-empirical (1000 permutations/pair) criteria; the cross-criterion Jaccard agreement rate is reported, and any edge present under only one criterion is flagged as fragile. The eval-vs-recompute disagreement (47 of 210 pairs) is quantified, not hidden.
hypotheses.estimand: Edge-set membership under each of four multiple-testing criteria applied to the same 210 directed Granger tests; pairwise Jaccard similarity between criteria's edge sets.
hypotheses.materiality_definition: Robustness is assessed jointly with materiality: an edge is robust only if it clears a criterion AND its variance_explained >= 0.02.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Report edge-set size and pairwise Jaccard for all six criterion pairs. Flag edges significant under exactly one criterion as fragile. Quantify eval-vs-recompute disagreement explicitly.

hypotheses.description: Block-bootstrap edge-set stability (per-edge selection frequency over 1000+ moving-block resamples) and tercile/temporal-stability reconciliation are reported against each primary criterion's edge set; an edge is "stable" only if it survives the bootstrap AND the criterion ladder.
hypotheses.estimand: Per-edge selection frequency under moving-block bootstrap (1000+ resamples); 95% stability interval per edge; Jaccard overlap of funding-tercile (3 splits) and 90-day/30-day rolling edge sets with each primary criterion's edge set.
hypotheses.materiality_definition: Stability requires both bootstrap selection frequency >= 0.5 (median) AND variance_explained >= 0.02.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Report per-edge selection frequency and 95% interval. Report tercile/rolling Jaccard vs each criterion. Declare an edge stable only if it meets bootstrap, ladder, and materiality jointly.

hourly_aggregation.rule: Collapse the event-level combined liquidation panel to (coin, UTC floor-hour) by count of events and sum of notional_usd. Build the COMPLETE hourly grid over each coin's observed span so zero-event hours are explicit zeros (flagged has_event=False; not silently fabricated). Funding predictor for an hour = mean of fundingRate across events inside that hour; for zero-event hours funding is carried from the most recent prior in-panel funding observation (forward fill of FUNDING only, never of the outcome), flagged funding_is_ffill=True. Hours with no prior funding are dropped and counted.
hourly_aggregation.inputs: notional_usd (count + sum), fundingRate (hourly mean), rv24h, rv168h (hourly, carried forward within coin), mark/ema_dist (hourly).

estimator_definitions.model: For each directed pair (A->B), regress B's hourly liquidation count on B's own lags (1..6) plus A's lagged liquidation counts (1..6), with an intercept. The restricted model includes only B's own lags + intercept.
estimator_definitions.partial_variance_explained: variance_explained = 1 - SSR_unrestricted / SSR_restricted, where SSR is the residual sum of squares of B on (own lags) vs (own lags + A lags). This is the per-edge materiality quantity CONTAGION-001 never computed.
estimator_definitions.granger_f_test: Joint F-test of the 6 source-lag coefficients in the unrestricted model; p-value from F(6, df_resid).
estimator_definitions.bonferroni_criterion: Edge present if Granger p < 0.01 / 210 (Bonferroni across 210 directed tests).
estimator_definitions.bh_fdr_criterion: Edge present if Granger p passes Benjamini-Hochberg step-up at q = 0.05 across 210 tests.
estimator_definitions.permutation_empirical_criterion: 1000 time-series permutations per directed pair; shuffle source coin's hourly series, recompute Granger F, build null; empirical p = fraction of null F >= observed F. Edge present if empirical p < 0.01.
estimator_definitions.jaccard: Jaccard(A, B) = |A intersect B| / |A union B| over directed-pair edge sets.
estimator_definitions.funding_tercile: Split hours by pair-level funding-rate differential into low/medium/high terciles; recompute the contagion network (Granger + lead-lag) within each tercile; report Jaccard vs each primary criterion's edge set.
estimator_definitions.temporal_stability: Rolling windows: 90-day and 30-day windows, 30-day step, over the panel span; recompute edge set within each window; report edge persistence and Jaccard vs each primary criterion's edge set.
estimator_definitions.block_bootstrap: 1000+ moving-block bootstrap resamples of the hourly panel (contiguous UTC blocks, jointly across coins to preserve common market shocks and serial dependence), deterministic seed; per-edge selection frequency = fraction of resamples where the edge is selected under the primary criterion; 95% edge-set stability interval from the empirical quantiles of selection frequencies.

inference.primary_se: Analytical F-test p-values plus permutation-empirical p-values (1000 permutations/pair).
inference.multiple_testing: Bonferroni across 210 directed Granger tests; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05; raw p<0.01; permutation-empirical p<0.01. All four criteria reported with edge-set sizes and pairwise Jaccard.
inference.block_bootstrap: Block bootstrap across contiguous UTC time blocks (jointly across coins) to preserve common market shocks and serial dependence; deterministic seed 20261121; per-edge selection frequency and 95% stability interval reported.

support_requires_H_recon_materiality: Per-edge variance_explained computed for all 210 directed pairs (replacing the uncomputed CONTAGION-001 flag)
Count of edges clearing the 0.02 floor reported with a bootstrap confidence interval
If count clearing floor == 0: H_recon_materiality = NOT_SUPPORTED; else SUPPORTED with CI
support_requires_H_recon_robustness: Edge-set size and pairwise Jaccard reported for all four criteria (raw, Bonferroni, BH-FDR, permutation-empirical)
Eval-vs-recompute disagreement (47 of 210 pairs) quantified explicitly
Edges significant under exactly one criterion flagged as fragile
support_requires_H_recon_stability: Per-edge block-bootstrap selection frequency and 95% interval reported for all 210 pairs
Funding-tercile and 90-day/30-day rolling Jaccard vs each primary criterion reported
Edge declared stable only if it survives bootstrap AND criterion ladder AND clears 0.02 materiality
